prompt:

2. Edit only this object so: The right tip of the jester's hat lost its bell. Target near x46%, y45%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The wardrobe's gold handle turned red. Target near x53%, y41%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The black cat gained a white tail tip. Target near x2%, y76%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The golden mug on the wardrobe lost its handle. Target near x64%, y6%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.
